newsitem.title: GERMANY: Daimler sets conservative goal for new V-class van.
newsitem.headline: Daimler sets conservative goal for new V-class van.

text.p: Mercedes-Benz AG chief executive Helmut Werner said on Monday that he expected about 16,000 of the carmaker's new V-class mini-van to be sold on an annual basis.
Werner told journalists at the introduction of the new vehicle that planning for it has been very conservative.
The new vehicle is based on the Mercedes Vito vehicle and will be built along with the Vito at the carmaker's Spanish plant in Vitoria, which has a capacity of 80,000 vehicles per year.
Werner said about one billion marks ($670.5 million) has been invested in the new mini-van, which is set to be launched in the European market in mid-September.
